Irene — thanks for the context and the matrix. I reviewed the numbers against the L5/L6 bands. Notes below: 

- Role leveling: Karthik has confirmed the hire as L5 (Senior). Band midpoint for L5 is $168k base; top-of-band is $190k. Given the candidate's background (system design at scale + 8 yrs), pushing to $190k is reasonable.
- Bonus: 12% is standard and fine. No change recommended.
- Equity: 0.35% is on the high end for L5; typical range is 0.15%–0.30%. If we move base to $190k, I recommend reducing equity to 0.25% to keep total dilutive spend aligned with budget.
- Signing bonus: option to offer a one-time $10k signing bonus if candidate needs to bridge a counteroffer — this keeps base and equity within budget.

If you want to keep the higher base at $195k (as Vivek suggested), we would likely need to cap equity at ~0.20% or require director sign-off for an exception. Marissa — please confirm approval flows for an exception to top-of-band pricing.

Suggested approved package (no exec exception required):
- Base: $190,000
- Bonus: 12% (target)
- Equity: 0.25% RSU over 4 yrs (1y cliff)
- Signing bonus: $10,000 (conditional)

Irene, if that looks good I can mark this as comp-approved and you can instruct TalentBridge to present.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Compensation & People Analytics
Redwood Inference
